title: Verify positive main flow for Admin User Authentication & Role-Based Access
preconditions: The user possesses a valid administrator account in OrangeHRM.
The user is on the OrangeHRM login page.

testSteps.action: Enter a valid administrator username in the Username field.
Enter the corresponding valid password in the Password field.

testSteps.expectedResult: User is redirected to the Dashboard page.

expectedResults: User is redirected to the Dashboard page.

title: Verify exception handling: System Unavailable
preconditions: The user possesses a valid administrator account in OrangeHRM.
The user is on the OrangeHRM login page.

testSteps.action: Set up scenario where Authentication service is unreachable or returns an error.

testSteps.expectedResult: Display a generic error message "Unable to process login at this time. Please try again later." and log the incident for investigation.

expectedResults: Display a generic error message "Unable to process login at this time. Please try again later." and log the incident for investigation.

title: Verify exception handling: Session Timeout During Login
preconditions: The user possesses a valid administrator account in OrangeHRM.
The user is on the OrangeHRM login page.

testSteps.action: Set up scenario where User remains idle on the login page beyond the session timeout limit.

testSteps.expectedResult: Refresh the login page and prompt the user to re-enter credentials.

expectedResults: Refresh the login page and prompt the user to re-enter credentials.

title: Verify alternate flow: Invalid Credentials
preconditions: The user possesses a valid administrator account in OrangeHRM.
The user is on the OrangeHRM login page.

testSteps.action: User enters a username and/or password that does not match any administrator account.
System validates the credentials, determines they are invalid, and displays an error alert "Invalid credentials" without indicating which field is incorrect.

expectedResults: Alternate pathway Invalid Credentials completes successfully

title: Verify alternate flow: Missing Required Fields
preconditions: The user possesses a valid administrator account in OrangeHRM.
The user is on the OrangeHRM login page.

testSteps.action: User leaves the Username and/or Password field empty.
System detects empty required fields and displays inline validation messages "Required" next to each empty field.

expectedResults: Alternate pathway Missing Required Fields completes successfully

title: Verify alternate flow: Forgot Password Navigation
preconditions: The user possesses a valid administrator account in OrangeHRM.
The user is on the OrangeHRM login page.

testSteps.action: User clicks the "Forgot your password?" link.
System navigates to the password reset request screen.

expectedResults: Alternate pathway Forgot Password Navigation completes successfully

title: Verify data validation rules for Admin User Authentication & Role-Based Access
preconditions: The user possesses a valid administrator account in OrangeHRM.
The user is on the OrangeHRM login page.

testSteps.action: Attempt input violating rules for: username (Required; maximum length 50 characters; must match an existing administrator account.), password (Required; minimum length 8 characters; must be stored and transmitted using secure hashing and TLS.)

Provide compliant inputs for: username (Required; maximum length 50 characters; must match an existing administrator account.), password (Required; minimum length 8 characters; must be stored and transmitted using secure hashing and TLS.)

expectedResults: System enforces input data requirements correctly
